answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond on a trellis stake, key-bound to it. Each epoch the beacon flashes a violet pulse; each identity must sign it back before the tide turns or its bond decays. Auditors replay the log: a missed pulse or reused stake burns the bond, and a shared key flags the cluster. First is 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 +70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. An honest identity pays 40 once and keeps it.
